editorial.summary: Brunswick is Melbourne's creative north - Sydney Road's live venues, vintage shops and cafes, with the Upfield line and bike path running its length. Italian and Greek roots, young share-house energy.
loves: Sydney Road - live music, vintage shops and one of Melbourne's best food strips
The Upfield bike path runs the length of the suburb
thingsToKnow: Sydney Road traffic and tram-hour crowds
editorial.transportNote: The Upfield line and the Route 19 tram both run through Brunswick.
